actions.label: insert-flower
actions.instruction: Use the right hand to grasp one pink flower stem, lift it, carry it to the vase, insert it, release it, and retract while the left hand stabilizes the bouquet.

phases.name: approach
phases.description: keep the torso stable and approach one pink stem with the open right hand

phases.name: grasp
phases.description: close the right fingers around one stem before the flower begins moving

phases.name: lift-carry
phases.description: lift the held flower vertically and carry it toward the vase opening

phases.name: insert
phases.description: lower the held stem into the vase while the left hand stabilizes the bouquet

phases.name: release
phases.description: open the right fingers and leave the flower supported by the vase

phases.name: retract
phases.description: retract both hands slightly without moving the inserted flower

actions.label: handover-flower
actions.instruction: Pick up one pink flower with the right hand, transfer the stem into the left hand at chest height, then separate the hands and display the flower only in the left hand.

phases.name: approach
phases.description: approach one pink flower with the open right hand

phases.name: grasp
phases.description: grasp the stem with the right fingers and begin lifting

phases.name: present
phases.description: bring the held stem to chest center while the left hand opens

phases.name: transfer
phases.description: place the stem into the left palm, close the left fingers, then release the right fingers

phases.name: separate
phases.description: move the empty right hand away while the left hand keeps holding the flower

phases.name: display
phases.description: hold the flower visibly in only the left hand without inserting it into the vase

actions.label: inspect-flower
actions.instruction: Lift one pink flower to eye level with the right hand, rotate the wrist clockwise to inspect it, pause, then lower it while maintaining the grasp and never placing it in the vase.

phases.name: approach
phases.description: approach one pink stem with the open right hand

phases.name: grasp
phases.description: grasp one stem with the right fingers before lifting it

phases.name: lift
phases.description: lift the flower to the robot eye line with continuous shoulder and elbow motion

phases.name: rotate
phases.description: rotate the right wrist clockwise by about 45 degrees while keeping the grasp

phases.name: pause
phases.description: pause with the flower held in front of the dark face panel

phases.name: lower
phases.description: lower the flower slightly without releasing it or placing it in the vase
